common_settings.title: Create Common Settings
common_settings.description:
These settings apply to all heating zones.

⚠️ IMPORTANT: You must create common settings first before adding any heating zones. Common settings include the boiler main switch, hysteresis value, and other global parameters that all zones will use.

data_description.boiler_main: Shared main boiler switch (same for all zones)
data_description.outdoor_temp_sensor: Outdoor temperature sensor - required for adaptive hysteresis (optional)
data_description.hysteresis: Base switching hysteresis - prevents frequent cycling (radiators only)
data_description.overheat_temp: If zone temperature reaches this value, heating shuts down immediately (safety)
data_description.adaptive_hysteresis_enabled: If enabled, hysteresis automatically increases in colder weather (more stable heating)
data_description.tempering_heating_enabled: Coordinated heating: when any zone heats, all zones below target also heat up (fewer on/off cycles)
data_description.limp_radiator_on_min: When a zone's sensor cannot be trusted and there is no backup, a radiator zone heats this many minutes per period (0 = no heating).
data_description.limp_radiator_period_min: Length of the cycle in minutes (10–720).
data_description.limp_underfloor_on_min: When a zone's sensor cannot be trusted and there is no backup, an underfloor zone heats this many minutes per period (0 = no heating).
data_description.limp_underfloor_period_min: Length of the cycle in minutes (10–720).
data_description.limp_outdoor_cutoff: When the outdoor temperature (or its estimate) reaches this value, limp mode does not heat (summer protection). Leave empty to disable.
data_description.outdoor_backup_sensor: Weather entity (weather.*) or sensor that limp mode uses when the outdoor sensor is gone.

zone.title: Create New Heating Zone
zone.description: Define your new heating zone parameters.

data_description.title: Unique name for the heating zone (e.g. Ground Floor, Upstairs)
data_description.heating_mode: Select heating mode based on your zone type
data_description.thermostat_type: Wall thermostat (accurate measurement) or radiator thermostat (measures higher temperature)
data_description.temp_offset: Temperature compensation for radiator thermostats - added to target temperature (default: 3°C)
data_description.sensor_entity_id: Temperature sensor entity for this zone
data_description.sensor_stale_hours: Safety: if the temperature sensor sends nothing for this long, the zone switches to the backup sensor or to limp mode (default: 2 h). Raise it only for sensors that report rarely.
data_description.door_sensors: Door/window sensors - pause heating when open (optional)
data_description.backup_sensor: If the zone sensor is lost, the zone switches to this one. If it is lost too, limp mode starts.
data_description.backup_sensor_offset: Added to the backup sensor reading (for example a negative value for a radiator-mounted sensor).
data_description.limp_on_min: Leave empty to use the common setting. Fill in both override fields together.
data_description.limp_period_min: Leave empty to use the common setting. Fill in both override fields together.

error.relay_required: At least one zone relay is required!
error.limp_period_range: The period must be a whole number between 10 and 720 minutes.
error.limp_on_exceeds_period: The on time cannot be longer than the period.
error.limp_pair_required: Fill in both override fields, or leave both empty.
